title: Beyond Pixels: Exploring DOM Downsampling for LLM-Based Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2508.04412v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The advent of large language models (LLMs) has sparked an evolution of autonomous web browsing agents: given a web browsing task and serialised user interface (UI) state, an LLM is expected to suggest input actions that incrementally solve the given task. The central challenge lies in serialising UI state for LLMs. Web agents have increasingly relied on grounded graphical UI (GUI) snapshots - screenshots augmented with visual cues - favoured for their modest input token footprint. Document object model (DOM) snapshots, serialised as HTML, represent a compelling alternative that leverages previously demonstrated HTML interpretation capabilities of LLMs. Their excessive token footprint, however, has precluded reliable deployment with web agents to date. We propose D2Snap, an algorithm to downsample the DOM, premised on preserving actionability and actionability-discriminating features. We evaluate D2Snap-downsampled DOM snapshots

translated_title: 超越像素：探索面向基于大语言模型网页代理的DOM降采样方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的出现推动了自主网页浏览代理的发展：给定一个网页浏览任务和序列化的用户界面（UI）状态，LLM需要给出能够逐步完成该任务的输入操作。核心挑战在于如何为LLM序列化UI状态。网页代理日益依赖带视觉标注的图形用户界面（GUI）快照——即附加了视觉提示的屏幕截图——因其适度的输入token开销而受到青睐。以HTML形式序列化的文档对象模型（DOM）快照则是一种颇具吸引力的替代方案，它可以充分利用LLM此前已被证明的HTML理解能力。然而，DOM快照过高的token开销一直阻碍着它在网页代理中的可靠部署。我们提出了D2Snap，一种DOM降采样算法，其核心思想是保留可操作性以及用于区分可操作性的特征。我们对经D2Snap降采样的DOM快照进行了评估。
tldr: 提出D2Snap算法，通过在降采样过程中保留可操作性及其判别特征来压缩DOM快照，在利用LLM的HTML理解能力的同时大幅降低token开销，使基于LLM的网页代理能够可靠地使用DOM信息。
en_tdlr: We propose D2Snap, a DOM downsampling algorithm that preserves actionability and actionability-discriminating features, enabling LLM-based web agents to reliably leverage DOM snapshots while keeping the token footprint low.
